layout: Desktop: gift-year ring card beside a 'Coming up' agenda, a one-line 'Jot down an idea' bar below, then people as cards. Phone: ring (the answer), idea form, agenda, people. Person detail opens in a sheet.
signature: The gift year: a ring of the next 12 months starting today at the top, the next 90 days shaded rose, each occasion a small gift box on its date (teal filled when bought, rose when ideas are saved, dashed when nothing yet, amber when that's close), with a countdown to the next occasion in the middle. The same gift-box glyph marks status everywhere and stacks into a 'shelf' on each person card.
mood: Warm, tidy and a little festive: wrapping paper rose on clean neutral paper, no clutter.
